description: Link any number of Storage Cells into one searchable, sortable inventory, ruled by a single enchanted Heart altar. Expand it, quick-dump into it, protect slots, and uncover the lore of the archmage Reigall.
body:
# Magic Storage

**One heartbeat. Endless storage.**

Tired of walls of chests? Magic Storage links any number of Storage Cells
into a single searchable inventory, governed by one enchanted Heart altar.

## Features
- 🫀 **Heart altar** — awaken it with a Magic Heart; it binds nearby Storage
  Cells into one big inventory.
- 🔍 **Powerful GUI** — search, sort (name / count / mod), category filters,
  autocomplete, scrolling grid.
- 💎 **Crystal Expanders** — snap them to the altar's faces to grow the network.
- ⚡ **Quick Dump** — one hotkey dumps your inventory into storage. Protect the
  slots you want to keep.
- 🎨 **Live fill indicators** — cells and the altar glow green → yellow → red.
- 🎵 **Reigall's Tuning Fork** — re-tune the
- 📖 **Lore-driven** — the story of archmage Reigall and princess Liza, told
  through the Liber Reigallus books. Recipes included.
- 🧙 **Villager trades** — the Magic Heart aians.

## Getting started
Craft a **Storage Cell** and a **Heart Storage** altar (recipes are in the
crafting recipe book and the starter book you get on first join). Buy a
**Magic Heart** from any librarian, insert it, place cells around it — done.

## Requires
- Minecraft **1.21.11**, **Forge 61+**
